About — plasticpreneur
As the global leader in small-scale plastic recycling and processing machines, we set the benchmark for safety, quality and zero-barrier access.

Your safety is our priority. All our machines are compliant with the highest safety and machinery standards, including CE, UKCA, ANSI, and CSA, ensuring a secure working environment for students and professionals alike.

Built to work and built to last. Our equipment delivers consistent, high-quality results, whether you are running an educational workshop, conducting a single material test or running a full production cycle.

We minimize barriers to entry. Our systems are designed for intuitive use, allowing you to launch your recycling and processing process in seconds without the need for prior technical expertise or complex training.

We don’t compromise on components. Every machine is meticulously built in Austria by our expert team using top-tier industrial parts to ensure robust reliability and long-term durability in any environment worldwide.
Compact & Efficient Footprint
